# The Digital Agila

> The Digital Agila is Jayson, a digital marketing specialist with six years in digital marketing and three years building in GoHighLevel. He builds websites, sales funnels, GoHighLevel automation, CRM, email marketing and SEO for businesses in Australia and the Philippines. Every project starts with a free 30-minute call and a fixed-price written proposal.

The Digital Agila is owned and operated by JPerucho Digital Marketing Services. All work is done remotely. Contact: hello@thedigitalagila.com

## Services

- [Services overview](https://thedigitalagila.com/services): Sales funnels, GoHighLevel automation, CRM setup, website design, email marketing, SEO and graphic design, built as one connected system.
- [Website designer and developer](https://thedigitalagila.com/website-designer): Fast, mobile-first websites that rank on Google and bring in leads.
- [GoHighLevel specialist and automation](https://thedigitalagila.com/gohighlevel-expert): GoHighLevel CRM, pipelines, workflows, email and SMS follow-up, and fixes for existing accounts.
- [SEO expert](https://thedigitalagila.com/seo-expert): On-page, technical and local SEO, from keyword research to Google Business Profile.

## Case studies

- [All case studies](https://thedigitalagila.com/work): Websites, SEO, logos and GoHighLevel automation for real clients.
- [CBF Supplements](https://thedigitalagila.com/case-study-cbf-supplements): A Shopify supplement store, logo and graphics built from scratch.
- [Gumnuts childcare](https://thedigitalagila.com/case-study-childcare): A redesigned WordPress website with on-page SEO for a Tasmanian childcare centre.
- [GoHighLevel lead nurture automation](https://thedigitalagila.com/case-study-gohighlevel-automation): Tagging, automated emails, follow-up and smart lists for an Australian business coach.
- [Pressing Eco](https://thedigitalagila.com/case-study-pressing-eco): A bilingual French and English WordPress website for a Swiss dry cleaning business.
- [Ronald T Curtis Plumbing](https://thedigitalagila.com/case-study-ron-curtis-plumbing): A logo, colour branding and Wix website for a licensed plumber.
- [Sorell Mechanical & Hire](https://thedigitalagila.com/case-study-sorell-mechanical): A one-page Canva site grown into five pages, with local SEO and a booking form.
